interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: A walk through the tool, pointing at each control.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Shifts, alignment, what is written and the MMFDB archive.

interactive.label: ➕ Files…
interactive.tooltip: Queue TTTR files; originals are retained when saving shifts.

interactive.label: 📁 Folder…
interactive.tooltip: Queue supported TTTR files recursively from a folder.

interactive.label: 🗄 Database…
interactive.tooltip: Select TTTR inputs from the MMFDB object store.

interactive.label: ➖ Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected file from the queue (it stays on disk).

interactive.label: 🧹 Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove queued files and preview shifts.

interactive.label: Show trigger lines
interactive.tooltip: Display the draggable count threshold (yellow) and target bin (green) on the histogram.

interactive.label: Log Y
interactive.tooltip: Display histogram photon counts on a logarithmic axis.

interactive.label: trigger_level
interactive.tooltip: Count threshold: auto-align finds, per detector, the first bin up to the peak at or above this level (the rising edge).

interactive.label: trigger_position
interactive.tooltip: Auto-align shifts each detector's rising edge to this micro-time bin.

interactive.label: ⚡ Auto align
interactive.tooltip: Shift each detector so its rising-edge threshold crossing lands on the target bin.

interactive.label: global_shift
interactive.tooltip: Added to every routing channel's shift; the micro-times wrap modulo the bin count.

interactive.label: 💾 Save shifted…
interactive.tooltip: One file: choose the shifted file's name. Several: choose a folder; one shifted file is written per input. Inputs are never changed.

interactive.label: output_folder
interactive.tooltip: Directory for a batch of shifted files; the inputs stay unchanged.

interactive.label: Save batch
interactive.tooltip: Write one shifted file per queued input into the batch folder.
